adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, the code does a `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams({ calcomUserId, appSlug }) })` with no authentication material (no shared secret/signature/header) and no timeout/AbortSignal. The finding’s broader claim about “anything that can reach that endpoint can mint an arbitrary user's access token” depends on how the external endpoint is implemented (not shown in this diff), but the lack of any auth/timeout in the outbound call is clearly present and is a concrete review concern introduced by the change.
